description_en: Queries the details of an access control policy
description_zh: 调用GetControlPolicy查询管控策略的详情
kebab_example: aliyun resourcemanager get-control-policy --policy-id cp-SImPt8GCEwiq0000 --biz-language zh-CN --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetControlPolicy

parameters.help_en: The ID of the access control policy
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en:
The language in which you want to return the description of the access control policy. Valid values:

zh-CN (default value): Chinese
en: English
ja: Japanese

This parameter is valid only for system access control policies
parameters.help_zh:
指定返回结果中管控策略描述的语言。取值：

zh-CN（默认值）：中文。
en：英文。
ja：日文。

该参数仅在系统管控策略时有效
parameters.name: language

ControlPolicy.description_en: The details of the access control policy

AttachmentCount.description_en: The number of times that the access control policy is referenced
AttachmentCount.description_zh: 管控策略被引用的次数

CreateDate.description_en: The time when the access control policy was created

Description.description_en: The description of the access control policy

EffectScope.description_en:
The effective scope of the access control policy. Valid values:

All: The access control policy is in effect for Alibaba Cloud accounts, RAM users, and RAM roles.
RAM: The access control policy is in effect only for RAM users and RAM roles
EffectScope.description_zh:
管控策略生效范围。取值：

All：表示该管控策略针对阿里云账号、RAM用户或RAM角色生效。
RAM：表示该管控策略仅针对RAM用户或RAM角色生效

PolicyDocument.description_en: The document of the access control policy

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the access control policy

PolicyName.description_en: The name of the access control policy

PolicyType.description_en:
The type of the access control policy. Valid values:

System: system access control policy
Custom: custom access control policy
PolicyType.description_zh:
管控策略类型。取值：

System：系统管控策略。
Custom：自定义管控策略

UpdateDate.description_en: The time when the access control policy was updated
